messages:
Clara Jensen: FYI autopay failure for Zephyr Labs (acct-ZL9) on INV-2289 ($4,120). Gateway decline says expired_card. Need quick options: one-time payment link, 48h grace, or temporary credit so they don't hit usage caps tonight.

Diego Rios: Pulled the gateway event: 
```json
{"status":"failed","error":{"type":"card_error","code":"card_declined","decline_code":"expired_card","message":"Card has expired"},"payment_method":"pm_6Tz...","customer":"cus_ZL9..."}
```

Meera Rao: Reached out to customer. AP team rotated cards but only updated internal vendors. They asked if we can provide a secure hosted pay link and a short grace period. Also asked whether ACH is an option (they don't have ACH with us yet).

Tom Briggs: We can create a single-use hosted link. Recommend pausing automated retries and dunning while CS engages. Propose a $750 temporary credit hold to keep them from hitting throttles. Finance needs to confirm.

billing-bot: Autopay retry policy: next attempt in 24h (attempts remaining: 2). Dunning emails scheduled per default cadence.

Diego Rios: Ops plan: suppress retries/dunning, generate one-time hosted payment page (no CVV retention), apply $750 temp credit, extend due date 48h. Manual collect only after successful hosted payment. Note: 3DS often fails on corporate virtual cards; if auth_required appears we'll advise using issuer app or try a different card.

Clara Jensen: Approve $750 temporary credit and 48h extension for Zephyr Labs. Waive auto late fee for this invoice. Pause dunning while CS sends link.

Meera Rao: Customer tried the hosted URL and got auth_required for 3DS. They requested phone payment as a fallback but legal reminded that we can't store CVV or key in plaintext. I'll re-send instructions to use their issuing bank's 3DS flow or try the new virtual card.

Stripe Connector: Hosted payment session created: https://pay.redwood.com/t/ZL77 (single-use, expires in 72h). Payment intent pi_4Mn... awaiting confirmation.

Tom Briggs: Finance confirmed hosted link only. @billing-bot please mark INV-2289: hold=awaiting_payment_update, suppress_dunning=true.

billing-bot: INV-2289 flagged: hold=awaiting_payment_update; dunning suppressed; autopay retries paused.

Diego Rios: Link sent and CRM updated. I'll only attempt manual collect after confirmation from CS that payment succeeded.

Clara Jensen: Quick recap: CS (Meera) coordinate with AP and confirm when payment completes; Ops (Diego) created link and applied $750 credit; Finance approved 48h grace. Leave thread open until payment clears. :white_check_mark:

Meera Rao: Customer will retry the 3DS flow this afternoon and may loop in their card issuer. I'll post an update here when it's settled.

Diego Rios: Noted. Will revert invoice state and remove hold once payment posts.

Clara Jensen: Thanks all.
